verdict.rationale: A government tax-services portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The "EIN online assistant" is a guided online application form with session limits and operating hours, not an AI agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
